newsitem.title: BELGIUM: FORMER BELGACOM ENGINEER ARRESTED ON THEFT CHARGES.
newsitem.headline: FORMER BELGACOM ENGINEER ARRESTED ON THEFT CHARGES.

text.p: Belgian police have arrested a former engineer of state telecommunications company Belgacom and charged him with stealing sensitive information, a Belgacom spokesman told Reuters on Wednesday.
"The last few days he had taken important information home, but everything has been recovered," spokesman Jan Margot said.
He said the engineer recently quit Belgacom. He could not confirm newspaper reports that the man had joined Belgacom's future rival Telenet and had committed industrial espionage.

Telenet, which was not immediately available for comment, aims to convert the extensive cable television network in Flanders, Belgium's Dutch-speaking northern half, to provide multimedia and voice telephone services from late 1997.
